Alex is designing a Python program that prints all the square numbers within 1 and a number specified by the user. Complete the program for him.(4 marks)
num = int(input("Please input a number: "))
if __________:
print("The number must be a positive integer.")
else:
i = 1
while __________:
____________________
____________________
[--Answer:
num < 1
i*i <= num
print(i * i)
i = i + 1
--]

items.stem:
The library of Kowloon University provides printing services for library users. They can pay the charges using the printing units stored in their library cards. The following shows the charges for making different types of copies:
Type of copies
Printing units required (per page)
black-and-white
1 unit
colour
5 units
A Python program is used in the printer to calculate the total amount of printing units required and check whether there are sufficient units in the user’s card before the printer starts printing. Users will be reminded to top up if there are insufficient printing units. When all pages have been printed, the program deducts the printing units required from the user’s card and outputs the balance. Complete the following pseudocode for the program.(4 marks)
balance  printing units in the user’s library card
pages  number of pages in the document to be printed
type  "black-and-white" or "colour"
charges  0
if type = "black-and-white" then
charges  __________
else if type = "colour" then
charges  __________
if _________________ then
Output "Insufficient printing units. Please top up."
else
balance  _________________
Output "Printing"
Output "Your remaining printing units:", balance
[--Answer:
pages
5 * pages
balance < charges
balance - charges
--]

items.stem: Data in a computer can be stored in various file formats and have different attributes. The format of a file is usually indicated by its file extension, which helps the computer read and decode the file. The filename and file extension are separated by a dot. For example, if a file is saved as “ict.pdf”, “ict” is the filename and “pdf” is the file extension.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Paul designs a program that receives a name of file inputted by the user, and then finds the file extension of the file. What is the file extension if the inputted name is “abc.def.txt”?(1 mark)

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Write the program in Python.(3 marks)
file = input()
extension = ""
N = len(file)
dot = _____
i = 0
while _______________:
if file[i] == ".":
dot = i
i = i + 1
if dot != -1:
for i in range(_____,_____):
extension = extension + file[i]
print(extension)
else:
print("No filename extension")
[--Answer:
(a) txt

A shopping mall is holding a lucky draw. Every shopper is given a card with a random integer on it. A shopper gets a gift if the number on their card meets one of the following conditions:
Number on the card
Gift
A multiple of 3
Restaurant coupon
A multiple of 8
Free cinema ticket
A multiple of both 3 and 8
Special gift
Hugo is the IT manager of this shopping mall. He is writing a Python program for shoppers to check whether they can get a gift and what the gift is. Complete the program for him.(4 marks)
num = int(input("Enter the number on your card: "))
gift = ""
if _____________________________:
gift = ____________________
elif ____________:
gift = ____________________
elif ____________:
gift = ____________________
if __________:
print("Congratulations! You can get a", gift)
else:
print("Better luck next time!")
[--Answer:
num % 3 == 0 and num % 8 == 0
"special gift."
num % 3 == 0
"restaurant coupon."
num % 8 == 0
"free cinema ticket."
gift != ""
--]
